newsitem.title: DUBAI: Dubai MTBE plant back on stream -traders.
newsitem.headline: Dubai MTBE plant back on stream -traders.

text.p: Dubai Natural Gas Co Ltd (DUGAS) has brought its 500,000 tonnes a year capacity MTBE plant back on stream after carrying out maintenance work, Gulf oil traders said on Thursday.

Operations at the MTBE plant in the Jebel Ali free zone in the United Arab Emirate of Dubai were suspended late last month by maintenance work, which traders said had been triggered by poor market returns for the gasoline-additive.
Traders estimated it would take up to 15 days for the plant to return to full production rates but that export commitments were already being met from stocks in storage.
